resources.string: Cesto uses Google’s Gemini with your own API key to read the items on your receipts and answer your questions. The key is stored encrypted on this phone and only sent to Google.
The two steps below open with this account. It can be different from your Gmail account. Leave it empty to use the account signed in in your browser.
This doesn’t look like an email address; the steps open with the account signed in in your browser.
Create a new project (or pick one you have). Turn on billing for it: on the free tier, Google may use what you send to improve its products, and that would include your receipts.
Create the key in Google AI Studio
Choose your project, create an API key and copy it. Then paste it below.
Google says this isn’t a valid API key. Copy it again from Google AI Studio.
The key works, but its project can’t use the Gemini API yet. Check in Google AI Studio that the key belongs to the right project.
Couldn’t reach Google. Check your internet connection and try again.
Google couldn’t check the key right now. Try again in a minute.
